outcome: Make the persisted record envelope able to widen: accept a set of record schema versions on read instead of one exact string, which is the expand stage the four-stage migration needs before anything else in it can run.
non_goals: Do not bump the envelope version in the same change that widens the accepted set
Do not silently accept a record whose payload the running code cannot interpret
Do not weaken the refusal for a record outside the accepted set

transitions.reason: both persisted-record readers compare record_schema with an exact inequality, so bumping the envelope severs the old readers immediately; widening the accepted set is the envelope's own expand stage and without it the shared state cannot survive the rollback that the self-update live milestone must demonstrate
